title: Programming assistant
description: Turn a technical goal into a clear, testable programming prompt.

fields.label: Technical goal or code
options: Build a list page with pagination and filters; first clarify its data shape and acceptance criteria.
Use error logs and a minimal reproduction to locate a bug; propose a minimal fix and regression checks.
Review the supplied code and rank findings by impact, with evidence and suggested changes.
Design normal, boundary and invalid-input tests for an existing function, explaining expected results.

title: AI animation & images
description: Build a polished image prompt or a complete animation storyboard and video prompts.

fields.label: Story, characters and setting
options: Create a skincare product image: one bottle centered, soft side light and a pale background, with room for the label.
Create front, side and back views of an original character, keeping clothing, proportions and colors consistent.
Plan a forest adventure animation: a kitten discovers a glowing seed; give each shot one clear action.
